rewrite_tone.description: The target persona, voice, or emotional tone to adopt when rewriting content.

rewrite_clarity_rules.description: Rules aimed at improving readability, reducing jargon, and ensuring the text is easy to understand.

rewrite_structure_rules.description: Guidelines structural formatting, such as paragraph length, bulleting preferences, or structural flow during modification.

rewrite_safety_rules.description: Guardrails and safety restrictions to prevent the inclusion of offensive, biased, or unauthorized information during rewrites.
